  <div class="hud">
    <button id="toggle" type="button">暂停</button>
    <label class="speed" for="speed">
      <span class="readout">速度</span>
      <input id="speed" type="range" min="0" max="3" step="0.1" value="1" />
    </label>
    <span class="readout">当前 <b id="speedVal">1.0×</b> · 空格键可暂停/继续</span>
  </div>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var rearWheel = document.getElementById('wheelRear');
  var frontWheel = document.getElementById('wheelFront');
  var crank = document.getElementById('crank');
  var rig = document.getElementById('rig');
  var roadMarks = document.getElementById('roadMarks');
  var trees = document.getElementById('trees');
  var clouds = document.getElementById('clouds');
  var nearLeg = document.getElementById('nearLeg');
  var farLeg = document.getElementById('farLeg');
  var nearFoot = document.getElementById('nearFoot');
  var farFoot = document.getElementById('farFoot');
  var toggleBtn = document.getElementById('toggle');
  var speedInput = document.getElementById('speed');
  var speedVal = document.getElementById('speedVal');

  var BBX = 465, BBY = 360, CRANK_R = 26, CRANK_RATIO = 0.55;
  var HIP_NEAR = { x: 394, y: 268 };
  var HIP_FAR = { x: 376, y: 260 };

  var MARK_SPAN = 120, TREE_SPAN = 300, CLOUD_SPAN = 400;

  var wheelAngle = 0, roadShift = 0, treeShift = 0, cloudShift = 0;
  var speed = 1, paused = false, lastTime = 0;

  function setLine(el, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
    el.setAttribute('x1', x1.toFixed(2));
    el.setAttribute('y1', y1.toFixed(2));
    el.setAttribute('x2', x2.toFixed(2));
    el.setAttribute('y2', y2.toFixed(2));
  }

  function drawLegs(crankDeg) {
    var rad = crankDeg * Math.PI / 180;
    var c = Math.cos(rad), s = Math.sin(rad);
    var nearX = BBX + CRANK_R * c, nearY = BBY + CRANK_R * s;
    var farX = BBX - CRANK_R * c, farY = BBY - CRANK_R * s;

    setLine(farLeg, HIP_FAR.x, HIP_FAR.y, farX, farY);
    farFoot.setAttribute('cx', farX.toFixed(2));
    farFoot.setAttribute('cy', farY.toFixed(2));

    setLine(nearLeg, HIP_NEAR.x, HIP_NEAR.y, nearX, nearY);
    nearFoot.setAttribute('cx', nearX.toFixed(2));
    nearFoot.setAttribute('cy', nearY.toFixed(2));
  }

  function tick(now) {
    if (!lastTime) { lastTime = now; }
    var dt = Math.min(now - lastTime, 64);
    lastTime = now;

    if (!paused) {
      wheelAngle = (wheelAngle + dt * 0.24 * speed) % 360;
      roadShift = (roadShift + dt * 0.24 * speed) % MARK_SPAN;
      treeShift = (treeShift + dt * 0.06 * speed) % TREE_SPAN;
      cloudShift = (cloudShift + dt * 0.03 * speed) % CLOUD_SPAN;
    }

    var crankAngle = wheelAngle * CRANK_RATIO;

    rearWheel.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + wheelAngle.toFixed(2) + ' 330 360)');
    frontWheel.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + wheelAngle.toFixed(2) + ' 600 360)');
    crank.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + crankAngle.toFixed(2) + ' 465 360)');
    drawLegs(crankAngle);

    roadMarks.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + (-roadShift).toFixed(2) + ' 0)');
    trees.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + (-treeShift).toFixed(2) + ' 0)');
    clouds.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + (-cloudShift).toFixed(2) + ' 0)');

    var bob = paused ? 0 : Math.sin(wheelAngle * Math.PI / 180 * 2) * 2.2;
    rig.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(0 ' + bob.toFixed(2) + ')');

    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  function setPaused(next) {
    paused = next;
    toggleBtn.textContent = paused ? '继续' : '暂停';
    toggleBtn.classList.toggle('paused', paused);
  }

  toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { setPaused(!paused); });

  speedInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
    speed = parseFloat(speedInput.value) || 0;
    speedVal.textContent = speed.toFixed(1) + '×';
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.key === ' ') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setPaused(!paused);
    }
  });

  setPaused(false);
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
